_comment: DARE trains on 8 GPUs, as it did before the examples moved to the model catalog. Applied after sft/overrides.json to DARE runs built from the catalog, whatever model= you pick. It also removes the ds_config batch fields some catalog files spell out for their own GPU count, so the server derives them for 8 GPUs. A model whose catalog sp_size or ep_size does not divide 8 is rejected before submission. Skipped with job_config=. With job_id=, the merged job is not submitted, but the example still reads settings such as the model, batch size and learning rate from it, so keep them matching the attached job. See recipes/README.md, "How an example builds its job", for how this file is merged.
